name: @etzhayyim/saiban-rw-free
description: RW-free reference implementation of the saiban PUBLIC judicial-reference layer (courts + judges + jurisdiction maps) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS. Mixed split: jiken (case) + trialEvent litigation/party-PII stays etzhayyim/E2E (consent-capability). Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000 + ADR-2606011400.
